title: Sportdeelname van etnische minderheidsgroepen in Amsterdam 1986
authors: Hoolt, J., Gemeente Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Bestuursinformatie, afd. onderzoek en statistiek (primary investigator)
contributors: Afd. sport en recreatie gemeente Amsterdam (research initiator)
Bestuursinformatie, Afd. onderzoek en statistiek, gemeente Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Participation in sports activities by members of ethnic minority groups in Amsterdam. Sports activities ( competitive and recreation sports ) in clubs / in sports hall of the local authorities / sports activities at school / frequency of sports activities / sports activities in native country. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education
